items.text: Lezi ziyizizukulwane zika-Esawu, lo ngu-Edomi.
U-Esawu wathatha abafazi bakhe emadodakazini aseKhanani; u-Ada, indodakazi ka-Eloni umHeti, no-Oholibama, indodakazi ka-Ana, indodakazi kaTsibeyoni umHivi;
noBasemati indodakazi ka-Ishmayeli, udadewabo kaNebhayoti.
UAda wamzalela u-Esawu u-Elifazi; uBasemati wazala uRehuweli;
U-Oholibama wazala oJewusi, noJalamu, noKora; lawo angamadodana kaEsawu azalelwa wona ezweni laseKhanani.

U-Esawu wathatha omkakhe, namadodana akhe, namadodakazi akhe, nabo bonke abantu bendlu yakhe, nezinkomo zakhe, nemfuyo yakhe yonke, nayo yonke impahla yakhe ayithola ezweni laseKhanani; waya ezweni ephuma ebusweni bomfowabo uJakobe.
Ngokuba ingcebo yabo yayingaphezu kokuba bangahlala ndawonye; nezwe ababengabafokazi kulo lalingenakulithwala ngenxa yemfuyo yabo.
U-Esawu wahlala entabeni yaseSeyiri: u-Esawu ungu-Edomi.
Lezi ziyizizukulwane zika-Esawu uyise wama-Edomi ezintabeni zaseSeyiri.
Lawa angamagama amadodana ka-Esawu: uElifazi, indodana ka-Ada, umka-Esawu, noRehuweli, indodana kaBasemati, umka-Esawu.
Amadodana ka-Elifazi: ngoThemani, no-Omari, noSefo, noGathamu, noKenazi.
UThimna wayeyisancinza sika-Elifazi indodana ka-Esawu; wazala u-Elifazi u-Amaleki. Lawa angamadodana ka-Ada umka-Esawu.
Lawa angamadodana kaRehuweli; oNahati, noSeraki, noShama, noMisa; labo babe ngamadodana kaBashimati umkaEsawu.
Lawa angamadodana ka-Oholibama, indodakazi ka-Ana, indodakazi kaSibeyoni, umka-Esawu; wazala u-Esawu uJewusi noJalamu noKora.
Laba babeyizikhulu zamadodana kaEsawu: amadodana kaElifazi, izibulo likaEsawu; Duke Teman, Duke Omar, Duke Zepho, Duke Kenaz,
nomnumzane uKora, nomnumzane uGathamu, nomnumzane u-Amaleki; lezi zizikhulu ezaphuma ku-Elifazi ezweni lakwa-Edomi; labo babe ngamadodana ka-Ada.

Lawa angamadodana kaRehuweli, indodana ka-Esawu; isikhulu esinguNahati, isikhulu esinguSeraki, isikhulu esinguShama, isikhulu esinguMisa; zizo ezo izikhulu zakwaRehuweli ezweni lakwaEdom; lawo angamadodana kaBashimati umkaEsawu.
Lawa angamadodana ka-Oholibama umka-Esawu; isikhulu esinguYehu, isikhulu esinguYalam, isikhulu esinguKora; zizo ezo izikhulu zakwa-Oholibhama, indodakazi ka-Ana, umkaEsawu.
Lawa angamadodana ka-Esawu, lo ngu-Edomi, lezi izikhulu zawo.
Lawa angamadodana kaSeyiri umHori, ayakhe kulelo zwe; uLothani, noShobali, noSibeyoni, no-Ana,
nguDishoni, no-Ezeri, noDishan; yilaba izikhulu zamaHori, abantwana bakwaSehire ezweni lakwaEdom.
Amadodana kaLothani ayengoHori noHemamu; udadewabo kaLothani kwakunguThimna.
Laba babe ngamadodana kaShobali; uAlvan, noManahati, no-Ebali, noZefo, no-Onam.
Laba babe ngamadodana kaSibeyoni; U-Aja no-Ana: kwakunguye u-Ana owathola iminyuzi ehlane lapho elusa izimbongolo zikayise uZibheyoni.
Laba babe ngamadodana ka-Ana; uDishoni no-Oholibama indodakazi ka-Ana.
Laba babe ngamadodana kaDishoni; uHemdani noEsbani noJitran noKeran.
Laba babe ngamadodana ka-Ezeri; UBilhan no-Saavan no-Akan.
Laba babe ngamadodana kaDisani; U-Uze no-Aran.
Lezi ziyizikhulu ezivela kumaHori; induna uLothani, induna uShobali, induna uZibheyoni, induna uAna,
umnumzane uDishoni, nomnumzane u-Eseri, nomnumzane uDishan; zizo ezo izikhulu ezaphuma eHori, phakathi kwezikhulu zazo, ezweni lakwaSehire.
Lawa angamakhosi abusa ezweni lakwa-Edomi, kungakabusi inkosi phezu kwabantwana bakwa-Israyeli;
UBela indodana kaBeyori wabusa kwa-Edomi, igama lomuzi wakhe laliyiDinihaba.
Wafa uBhela, wathi uYobhabhi, unyana kaSeraki, waseBhotsera, walawula esikhundleni sakhe.
Wafa uYobhabhi, wathi uHusam, wasezweni lakwaTeman, walawula esikhundleni sakhe.
Wafa uHusam, wathi uHadadi, unyana kaBhedadi, owawabulalayo amaMidiyan emhlabeni wakwaMowabhi, walawula esikhundleni sakhe; igama lomuzi wakhe laliyi-Awiti.
Wafa uHadadi, wathi uSamla waseMasereka walawula esikhundleni sakhe.
Wafa uSamla; uSawule, waseRehobhoti yoMlambo, walawula esikhundleni sakhe.
Wafa uSawule, wathi uBhahali-hanan, unyana ka-Akebhore, walawula esikhundleni sakhe.
Wafa uBhahali-hanan, unyana ka-Akebhore, wathi uHadari walawula esikhundleni sakhe; igama lomuzi wakhe laliyiPhawu; igama lomkakhe lalinguMehetabheli, indodakazi kaMatredi, indodakazi kaMeshahabi.
Lawa angamagama ezikhulu ezaphuma ku-Esawu ngemindeni yazo nangezindawo zazo ngamagama azo; induna uThimna, induna u-Alva, induna uJetet,
uDuke Oholibama, uDuke Ela, uDuke Pinon,
induna uKenazi, induna uThemani, induna uMibisari,
umnumzane uMagidiyeli, nomnumzane u-Iramu; yizo ezo izikhulu zakwaEdom ngeendawo zazo zokuhlala ezweni lefa lazo: nguEsawu uyise wamaEdom.
